WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment",
        SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)::INTEGER AS "year",
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS "total_consumption"
    FROM
        "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN
        "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE
        c."currency" = 'EUR'
        AND SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY
        c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)
),
segment_yearly AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        "year",
        "total_consumption",
        LAG("total_consumption", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "segment" ORDER BY "year") AS "prev_year_consumption"
    FROM
        yearly_consumption
),
percentage_change AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        "year",
        "total_consumption",
        "prev_year_consumption",
        CASE
            WHEN "prev_year_consumption" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (("total_consumption" - "prev_year_consumption")::FLOAT / "prev_year_consumption") * 100
        END AS "percentage_increase"
    FROM
        segment_yearly
    WHERE
        "year" = 2013
)
SELECT
    "segment",
    "percentage_increase"
FROM
    percentage_change
WHERE
    "segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
ORDER BY
    "percentage_increase" DESC NULLS LAST

),
consumption_data AS (
    
    SELECT
        ym."customerid",
        MAX(CASE WHEN ym."date" LIKE '2012%' THEN ym."consumption" END) AS consumption_2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ym."date" LIKE '2013%' THEN ym."consumption" END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM "yearmonth" ym

    (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM consumption_data;
